text: Steenbarger: the room does not hold h1_close_above:bar_high; it is a tie-break, and quoting oneil, an objector, overstates it. With D close_vs_swing_high_pct 7.98 price is well in front of value, and elder_5d [10,10,10,10,10] is a summer plateau, not the buying season (C20, C24 unsourced). oneil calls it the late band; wyckoff and I want the test of value. My trigger: the pullback into the 20-day zone (ma20 30.29) and an hourly close back above it while elder holds not-red (C9, C10). That clears me; a fresh closing high would buy further from value.
